final: SELECT t.AlbumId, AVG(t.UnitPrice) as avg_unit_price, AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS FLOAT) / t.Milliseconds) as avg_bytes_per_ms, AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS FLOAT) / t.Milliseconds) - (SELECT AVG(CAST(t2.Bytes AS FLOAT) / t2.Milliseconds) FROM Track t2 WHERE t2.Bytes IS NOT NULL AND t2.Milliseconds > 0) as difference_from_avg FROM Track t WHERE t.Bytes IS NOT NULL AND t.Milliseconds > 0 GROUP BY t.AlbumId ORDER BY difference_from_avg DESC LIMIT 10
